meta.description: PrintPro is Chaiyaboon Brothers Group's merchandise production and brand OEM division — DTG, screen printing, sublimation and embroidery, backed by 70+ years of in-house ink manufacturing.

hero.credit: On location, Bangkok · PrintPro print worn by our artist collaborator
hero.sub: Merchandise production and brand OEM — DTG, silkscreen, sublimation and embroidery, built on 70+ years of in-house ink manufacturing. One partner, from ink formula to finished merch on your doorstep.

story.heading:
70 Years of Ink.
Now We Make the Merch.
story.lede: Chaiyaboon Brothers Group has been the backbone of Thailand's screen printing industry since the 1950s — supplying inks to garment manufacturers, print shops, and textile businesses across Southeast Asia. PrintPro is CBG's dedicated merchandise production division, built to bring that same ink expertise directly into the world of event, artist, and brand merchandise.

ecosystem.heading:
From Ink Formula
to Finished Merch.
ecosystem.lede: Because we manufacture our own inks, we control every variable other suppliers can't — color accuracy, wash durability, eco-compliance, and cost. That's the unfair advantage.
ecosystem.step1Body: CBG formulates and produces screen printing, UV, and eco inks in-house — 70 years of R&D.
ecosystem.step2Body: Direct relationships with fabric mills across Thailand and SE Asia — cotton, rPET, organic options. Official exclusive distributor of ArriveGuide in Thailand.
ecosystem.step3Body: Screen print, DTG (Kornit), sublimation, embroidery, garment dye — all under one roof.
ecosystem.step4Body: PrintPro packages, QC inspects, and ships to your warehouse or direct to event site.

others.heading:
If It Can Be Screened,
We Can Merch It.
others.lede: The real range goes beyond apparel and headwear. Across Chaiyaboon's full client base, any object that can take a screen becomes merch — umbrellas, coolers, tumblers, footwear, packaging. If it holds an image, we can run it.
others.fineprint: Sample pieces from the exhibition floor · produced across PrintPro & the wider Chaiyaboon Brothers Group client base.

print.heading:
Three Technologies.
Endless Possibilities.
print.dtgSub1: Kornit DTG — mass production. Industrial-grade, photographic quality, high-volume runs with no color limits, water-based eco inks, no screens required.
print.dtgSub2: Brother GTX — live on-site, small orders. Deployed at your festival: fans pick a design and watch it print in ~2 minutes.
print.screenSub1: All ink types, in-house — CBG manufactures plastisol, water-based, UV, discharge, metallic, glow, and puff inks. 70 years of formulation.
print.screenSub2: Production network — our ink clients are printing shops across Thailand. When demand scales, we activate this network for extra capacity on demand.
print.sublimationSub1: DGI Printers — in-house equipment for high-resolution dye-sublimation: all-over prints, polyester garments, soft accessories, full-bleed designs.
print.sublimationSub2: Expanded capacity — additional sublimation capacity via our production partner network for large-scale or time-sensitive orders.

sustainability.heading:
Made for a
Greener Merch Run.
sustainability.card1Body: CBG's ink factory holds REACH, RoHS, and EN71 environmental certifications — meeting EU safety and chemical compliance standards across all ink formulations.
sustainability.card2Body: Our screen printing inks are formulated low-VOC — safer for production workers, printers, and end consumers, with reduced environmental impact during curing.
sustainability.card3Body: All DTG printing on our Kornit machines uses ECO TEX certified inks exclusively — water-based, skin-safe, and certified for direct contact with garments.
sustainability.card4Body: rPET recycled polyester and organic cotton options available across all apparel SKUs — sourced through ArriveGuide and our SE Asia fabric mill network.

why.heading:
Five Reasons to
Talk to Us.
why.reason1Body: We don't just print on garments — we manufacture the inks that print them. A track record no new-entry supplier can replicate.
why.reason2Body: From ink formulation to finished garment — sourcing, printing, QC, and delivery are all connected. Fewer handoffs, fewer problems.
why.reason3Body: 39 SKUs across apparel, headwear, and accessories — from core tees to on-site live-printed keepsakes.
why.reason4Body: REACH, RoHS, EN71, ZDHC, and ECO TEX certifications, plus rPET and organic cotton options.
why.reason5Title: Flexible, Small Runs to Large-Scale Volume
why.reason5Body: Brother GTX for live on-site drops. Kornit DTG and screen printing for mass production. One partner, any scale — 50 pieces to 50,000 units.
